text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I ended up visiting an amusement park run by Mejiro Bright's parents.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Lady Bright, this haunted house is our proudest masterpiece!
We guarantee you'll be terrified!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I have been looking forward to this so very much♪
I shall try it out right away~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We want you to be a test monitor for
a haunted house scheduled to open"... That was the reason for the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Lady Bright has just entered!
She is advancing eastward at a walking speed of 25 meters per minute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Mejiro Bright, I was led into the haunted house's staff room.
Staring at the surveillance monitor there was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Bright will be surprised...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They called me in as an advisor
because they wanted to scare someone like Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, though, I don't recall
ever seeing Bright look surprised.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: That is indeed the case...! Up until now, our park's haunted house has suffered consecutive defeats against Lady Bright—

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Howeeeeeever!
This haunted house is the scariest in history!
And the culmination of my life as a manager!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
With top-class terror, I am certain
our young lady will thoroughly enjoy it as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Alongside the manager, who looked as if he had staked his entire life on this project, I decided to watch over Mejiro Bright through the monitor...

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Lady Bright breached the abandoned hospital area with a smile!
Our first line of defense has fallen...!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Calm down! This is well within expectations!
Prepare to deploy the 'Bloody Muscle Lady'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's finally time.
I wonder if Bright will be scared...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a bloodstained doll!
Dober came up with the face design, and I supervised the body sculpt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It looks so terrifyingly realistic that even one glance is ghastly! Bright is definitely going to be shocked!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet! Draw them in until the absolute last second!
Counting 3, 2, 1—Fireeeee!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...My, this is a doll, isn't it~?
My goodness, she has such a lovely face~âª"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, this sturdy physique somehow
reminds me of big sister Ryan.
Ufufu, there, there~♪"

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Lady Bright is petting the doll!
W-What an extraordinary lady...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I might have made the doll's face
a bit too pretty...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I got a little too obsessed with the muscle details, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bright continued to breeze past the haunted house's tricks with total composure after that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Ryan. Someone who knows Bright well...
I mean, isn't there someone right there too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's it...! Aside from us,
there's someone else here who knows Bright inside out...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Trainer-san might
be able to spot Bright's weakness!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Would you mind taking on the role
of surprising the young lady...?
I'm begging you like this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The manager unleashed a flying prostration.
Unable to turn down his desperate pleading, I was led straight into the room—

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
O Trainer, what a horrifying sight...
As expected of Hollywood-grade special effects makeup!
You are truly a bona fide zombie now!
choice_data_list: I'm not happy about this at all...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Now, go before Lady Bright looking like that!
'Final Operation T', commence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!
If you psych yourself up, you can totally do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, I suppose this door is the exit~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appearing before Mejiro Bright at the perfect,
instructed timing, I shout at the top of my lungs...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, Trainer-sama~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Is that costume of yours a zombie~?
It looks wonderfully authentic~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Come, let me walk you to the exit~♪
Please let me see your makeup under the bright light."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Final Operation T" ended in failure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to explain the whole situation
to Bright as she exited the haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, Bright...
I'm sorry for sneaking around trying to surprise you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I felt kind of bad about it too,
but the manager told me to keep quiet...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I got carried away too!
Sorry, I got carried away too!
But she didn't seem scared at all...
But she didn't seem scared at all, did she...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I felt kind of bad about it too,
but the manager told me to keep quiet...
choice_data_list: Sorry, I got carried away too!
Sorry, I got carried away too!
But she didn't seem scared at all...
But she didn't seem scared at all, did she...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In other words, all three of you
put together a surprise just for me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to fully
enjoy the haunted house.
My sincerest gratitude~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, by the way, Trainer,
about your costume and makeup~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Where would I need to go to have that done?~
I would simply love to give it a try myself~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mejiro Bright remained completely oblivious
to everything right up until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even feel surprised,
it took me a moment just to process
what was happening~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it would be even more surprising
if you gave an advance explanation.
Like saying, 'A doll will appear in five seconds,' and so on~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, the opened haunted house turned out to be
a huge hit with the general guests.
